reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message to confirm both notes:

  Greywater rollout at Marrow Fieldworks: deadline 9 October
  Juniper rollout at Tansley Parcel: 131 seats

His message was dated 19 October, so 9 October had already passed. I pointed that out and asked him to tell me if he meant a different date.

He said no action was needed, so I didn't take any. Both are operational facts, not money figures, so they're fine to have in the channel. The brain had already saved his message from #central-team.
